title: MRI of the lumbar spine for low back pain (ILLUSTRATIVE criteria set)
source_note: Paraphrased, simplified criteria modelled on common payer imaging policies. NOT verbatim from any CMS LCD/NCD and NOT clinically validated. Replace with criteria summarised from a real MCD LCD (Phase 0) before making any claim about real policies.

items.text: Days since onset of current low back pain episode
Weeks of supervised physical therapy completed for this episode
Has a trial of NSAID analgesic therapy been documented for this episode?
Does the patient have a documented history of malignancy?
Is a progressive or severe neurological deficit (e.g. foot drop, cauda equina signs) documented?
Has a lumbar spine MRI been performed within the past 12 months?

criteria.text: Low back pain symptoms for at least 6 weeks (42 days)
Failed conservative therapy: at least 6 weeks of physical therapy OR a documented NSAID trial
Red flag present: history of malignancy OR progressive/severe neurological deficit
No lumbar spine MRI within the past 12 months
